'''Vargos 9''',<ref name="Relic" /> also known as '''Vargos Nine''', was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Timelines" /> in the [[Vargos system]] of the [[Mortex sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located in grid square R-5 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Around [[33 ABY]], during her [[Mika Grey's hunt for relics|search]] for [[Sith artifact|Sith relics]], the [[archaeologist]] [[Mika Grey]] encountered a [[Raith's squad|group]] of [[First Order Raider]]s on Vargos 9,<ref name="Timelines" /> who also sought [[Force artifact|relics]] for their [[Supreme Leader]], [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]].<ref name="DB">{{Databank|first-order-raiders|First Order Raiders}}</ref> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Grey believed she had eluded their pursuit on Vargos 9 until [[Mission to Ashas Ree|encountering]] the [[First Order]] [[trooper]]s on the [[planet]]<ref name="Relic" /> [[Ashas Ree]], where they had tracked her.<ref name="Timelines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vargos 9 was first mentioned in "[[The Relic Raiders]]," the seventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',<ref name="Relic" /> which aired on [[November 17]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> It was later identified in the [[2023]] release of ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' as "Vargos Nine."<ref name="Timelines" />
